Facts: On Aug 23, 2015, at 16:00, defendant Li2 (李2某) in Shijiazhuang Chang'an district, at foot massage shop of Zhang1 (张某1) due to parking dispute, Li2 assaulted Zhang1, causing right 5th and 6th rib fractures. The injury is classified as light injury (轻伤) second degree. So the crime is intentional injury (故意伤害) causing light injury. The typical charge: 故意伤害罪 (intentional injury). Check if any other charges? Possibly "非法拘禁"? No. Only assault. So single charge.

Thus final answer: "故意伤害".
